alembic_version

CREATE TABLE alembic_version (
	version_num VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT alembic_version_pkc PRIMARY KEY (version_num)
)
graph_diagnostics

CREATE TABLE graph_diagnostics (
	repository_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	severity TEXT NOT NULL, 
	path TEXT NOT NULL, 
	language TEXT NOT NULL, 
	message TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (repository_id, ordinal), 
	FOREIGN KEY(repository_id) REFERENCES repository_graphs (repository_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
graph_diagnostics_path
CREATE INDEX graph_diagnostics_path ON graph_diagnostics (repository_id, path)
graph_edges

CREATE TABLE graph_edges (
	repository_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	target_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	relationship TEXT NOT NULL, 
	confidence TEXT NOT NULL, 
	path TEXT, 
	evidence TEXT, 
	line INTEGER, 
	type_only BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (repository_id, ordinal), 
	FOREIGN KEY(repository_id, source_key) REFERENCES graph_nodes (repository_id, node_key) ON DELETE NO ACTION, 
	FOREIGN KEY(repository_id, target_key) REFERENCES graph_nodes (repository_id, node_key) ON DELETE NO ACTION, 
	FOREIGN KEY(repository_id) REFERENCES repository_graphs (repository_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
graph_edges_source
CREATE INDEX graph_edges_source ON graph_edges (repository_id, source_key, relationship, ordinal)
graph_edges_target
CREATE INDEX graph_edges_target ON graph_edges (repository_id, target_key, relationship, ordinal)
graph_files

CREATE TABLE graph_files (
	repository_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	node_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	byte_count INTEGER, 
	sha256 TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (repository_id, node_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(repository_id, node_key) REFERENCES graph_nodes (repository_id, node_key) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
graph_mutation_candidates

CREATE TABLE graph_mutation_candidates (
	repository_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	file_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	path TEXT NOT NULL, 
	language TEXT NOT NULL, 
	source_hash TEXT NOT NULL, 
	kind TEXT NOT NULL, 
	operator TEXT, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (repository_id, candidate_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(repository_id, file_key) REFERENCES graph_files (repository_id, node_key) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
graph_mutation_candidates_file
CREATE INDEX graph_mutation_candidates_file ON graph_mutation_candidates (repository_id, file_key)
graph_node_decorators

CREATE TABLE graph_node_decorators (
	repository_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	node_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	decorator TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (repository_id, node_key, ordinal), 
	FOREIGN KEY(repository_id, node_key) REFERENCES graph_symbols (repository_id, node_key) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
graph_node_metrics

CREATE TABLE graph_node_metrics (
	repository_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	node_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	line_count INTEGER, 
	parameter_count INTEGER, 
	base_complexity INTEGER, 
	nested_complexity INTEGER, 
	loop_complexity INTEGER, 
	total_complexity INTEGER, 
	max_decision_depth INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (repository_id, node_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(repository_id, node_key) REFERENCES graph_nodes (repository_id, node_key) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
graph_nodes

CREATE TABLE graph_nodes (
	repository_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	node_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	parent_key TEXT, 
	ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	type TEXT NOT NULL, 
	kind TEXT NOT NULL, 
	level TEXT NOT NULL, 
	name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	language TEXT, 
	qualified_name TEXT, 
	path TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (repository_id, node_key), 
	UNIQUE (repository_id, ordinal), 
	FOREIGN KEY(repository_id, parent_key) REFERENCES graph_nodes (repository_id, node_key) ON DELETE NO ACTION DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, 
	FOREIGN KEY(repository_id) REFERENCES repository_graphs (repository_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
graph_nodes_level
CREATE INDEX graph_nodes_level ON graph_nodes (repository_id, level)
graph_nodes_name
CREATE INDEX graph_nodes_name ON graph_nodes (repository_id, name COLLATE NOCASE)
graph_nodes_parent
CREATE INDEX graph_nodes_parent ON graph_nodes (repository_id, parent_key)
graph_nodes_path
CREATE INDEX graph_nodes_path ON graph_nodes (repository_id, path)
graph_symbols

CREATE TABLE graph_symbols (
	repository_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	node_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	start_line INTEGER, 
	start_column INTEGER, 
	end_line INTEGER, 
	end_column INTEGER, 
	signature TEXT, 
	visibility TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (repository_id, node_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(repository_id, node_key) REFERENCES graph_nodes (repository_id, node_key) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
repositories

CREATE TABLE repositories (
	id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	location TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
repositories_name_unique
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX repositories_name_unique ON repositories (lower(name))
repository_graphs

CREATE TABLE repository_graphs (
	repository_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	imported_at INTEGER NOT NULL, graph_revision TEXT, schema_version INTEGER, indexed_at TEXT, root_name TEXT, root_path TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (repository_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(repository_id) REFERENCES repositories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
